submission.justification: Module-D1 (wavelength-shifting bar with SiPM readout) at 30% wall coverage gives the highest light collection among the robust designs: 37.9 PE/MeV in the Geant4 simulation (100k events). Module-D2 had the highest light yield in the 2025 summary (38 PE/MeV at 20% coverage), but it fails thermal cycling at 30% (thin light-guide bonding cracks on cooldown), far above the 5% limit, and modules cannot be accessed after the cryostat is filled, so it was rejected. Module-D3 is robust but gives only 24.1 PE/MeV at 30%. Module-D1 passes thermal cycling with 2% failures after 20 cycles. The meeting notes confirm enough feedthroughs for 30% coverage.

requirements.requirement: Module must be one of the three candidate designs

requirements.evidence: Module-D1 at 30%: 37.9 PE/MeV. Module-D3 at 30%: 24.1 PE/MeV. Module-D2 is higher on paper (38 PE/MeV at 20% in 2025 summary) but excluded on robustness grounds.

requirements.requirement: Modules must be robust (thermal cycling failures <= 5% after 20 cycles)

requirements.evidence: Recommended coverage 30%, the upper bound of the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended module design and coverage
